limits: MS/MS does not observe the sequence of every cleavage. All graph edges are formula-compatible hypotheses.
Every retained peak (m/z >=40, intensity >=1%, 1.5 Da below precursor, top 300 cap) is in observations, including unassigned peaks.

For this illustrative graph, assignments prefer a cleavage-compatible formula within mass tolerance, then the smallest error. All alternatives and the original closest-mass label are retained. Primary-sample summary assignments remain closest-mass only.
A drawn cap is a neutral H-saturated analogue, not a proven product-ion structure. Unique means unique within this bounded enumeration.
Five or fewer energies and the best-covered observation at each energy are chosen for illustration; no general causal energy conclusion.
